design_overview: StudyCircle is a clean, card-based mobile-first web app. An indigo header and primary actions give strong hierarchy, and a four-tab bottom bar leads users through the core flow of finding notes, joining groups, contributing, and managing their profile. Moderation tools appear only for moderators.

screens.name: Sign Up / Log In
screens.purpose: Let students register with a university email, verify it, and log in.

key_components.name: Brand Header
key_components.styling: Indigo gradient banner with white logo and tagline 'Study smarter, together'; rounded bottom corners.
key_components.interaction: Static branding; no action.

key_components.name: Auth Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control with 'Sign Up' and 'Log In'; active tab filled indigo, inactive grey text.
key_components.interaction: Switches the form between sign up and log in.

key_components.name: Full Name Input
key_components.styling: 52px rounded field with light border, user icon, placeholder 'Full name'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type name.

key_components.name: University Email Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field with placeholder 'name@university.edu'; shows green helper text when domain is valid.
key_components.interaction: Validates university domain as the user types.

key_components.name: Password Input
key_components.styling: Masked field with placeholder 'Password (min 8 characters)' and a show/hide toggle.
key_components.interaction: Toggle reveals or hides the password.

key_components.name: Create Account Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo pill button, white bold text 'Create Account', soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Submits form; opens Verify Email state.

key_components.name: Verification Banner
key_components.styling: Light green card: 'Check your inbox. Tap the verification link to activate your account.' with 'Resend email' link.
key_components.interaction: Resend sends a new link; confirmed link opens Home.

key_components.name: Privacy Note
key_components.styling: Small grey text: 'By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy (GDPR compliant).'
key_components.interaction: Links open policy pages.

screens.user_flow: App launch → Sign Up or Log In → verify email → Home. Returning users log in and go straight to Home.

screens.name: Home - Browse Notes
screens.purpose: Search, filter, and browse study notes by course and topic.

key_components.name: Top Bar
key_components.styling: Indigo header with greeting 'Hi, Maya' and a notification bell with red dot.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens the notifications list.

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: White rounded search bar with shadow, placeholder 'Search notes, courses, topics'.
key_components.interaction: Typing returns matching notes sorted by relevance.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: Square outlined button beside search bar; indigo badge shows active filter count.
key_components.interaction: Opens filter sheet: university, course, topic, rating.

key_components.name: Course Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrolling pills: 'All', 'CS101', 'BIO204', 'ECON110'; selected chip filled indigo.
key_components.interaction: Filters the note list by course.

key_components.name: Note Card
key_components.styling: White rounded card with PDF thumbnail, bold title, 'CS101 · Algorithms', author, 4.6 star rating, download count.
key_components.interaction: Opens Note Detail screen.

key_components.name: Bookmark Toggle
key_components.styling: Round icon button at card top-right; outlined grey, filled amber when saved.
key_components.interaction: Saves note to Bookmarks without leaving the list.

key_components.name: Sort Control
key_components.styling: Text link 'Sort: Relevance' with a chevron above the list.
key_components.interaction: Opens options: Relevance, Newest, Top rated.

key_components.name: Empty Results State
key_components.styling: Centered message 'No notes found' with outlined button 'Upload the first note'.
key_components.interaction: Button opens Upload Note screen.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with four tabs: Home, Groups, Upload, Profile. Active tab indigo with label.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Arrives from login or the Home tab. Tap a note card to open Note Detail, the Upload tab to share notes, or Groups to study together.

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: View, download, rate, comment on, bookmark, and report a note.

key_components.name: Detail Header
key_components.styling: Transparent top bar with back arrow, title 'Note' and a share icon.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Home; share copies the note link.

key_components.name: Note Preview
key_components.styling: Large rounded first-page preview with a page counter '1 / 12'.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens full-screen viewer.

key_components.name: Note Info
key_components.styling: Title 'Sorting Algorithms Summary', tags 'CS101' and 'Algorithms', author avatar, upload date, average rating 4.6.
key_components.interaction: Author name opens their profile.

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo button 'Download PDF' with file size '2.4 MB'.
key_components.interaction: Downloads the file and shows a success toast.

key_components.name: Bookmark Button
key_components.styling: Outlined secondary button 'Bookmark'; becomes amber-filled 'Saved' after tapping.
key_components.interaction: Adds note to the Bookmarks list in Profile.

key_components.name: Star Rating Input
key_components.styling: Five tappable amber stars with the label 'Rate this note'.
key_components.interaction: Submits 1-5 rating; average updates instantly.

key_components.name: Comment Input
key_components.styling: Rounded multiline field with placeholder 'Write a helpful comment' and an indigo 'Post' button.
key_components.interaction: Posts comment to the list below.

key_components.name: Comments List
key_components.styling: Rows with avatar, name, comment text, time, and a small 'Report' text link.
key_components.interaction: Report opens the report sheet for that comment.

key_components.name: Report Modal
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet 'Report content' with radio reasons (Inappropriate, Copyright, Spam), optional details field, red 'Submit Report' button.
key_components.interaction: Sends report to moderator queue; shows confirmation toast.

screens.user_flow: Opened from a Note Card or a bookmark. Back returns to the list; Report sends the item to the Moderation Queue.

screens.name: Upload Note
screens.purpose: Upload a PDF or image note with title, course, and topic tags.

key_components.name: Upload Header
key_components.styling: White top bar with close icon, title 'Upload Note', and a 'Cancel' text action.
key_components.interaction: Cancel discards the form and returns to Home.

key_components.name: File Dropzone
key_components.styling: Dashed indigo border card with the text 'Tap to choose a PDF or image' and 'Max 20 MB'.
key_components.interaction: Opens file picker; selected file shows name and a remove icon.

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field with label 'Title' and placeholder 'e.g. Sorting Algorithms Summary'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type the title.

key_components.name: University Select
key_components.styling: Rounded select field with placeholder 'Select university' and a chevron.
key_components.interaction: Opens searchable list of universities.

key_components.name: Course Select
key_components.styling: Rounded select field, required, placeholder 'Select course (e.g. CS101)'.
key_components.interaction: Opens searchable course list.

key_components.name: Topic Tags Input
key_components.styling: Field with placeholder 'Add topic tags' and removable indigo-tint chips.
key_components.interaction: Enter adds a tag chip.

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: Multiline field, placeholder 'Describe what this note covers (optional)'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type description.

key_components.name: Security Notice
key_components.styling: Light amber strip: 'Files are scanned for malware before publishing.'
key_components.interaction: Informational only.

key_components.name: Publish Button
key_components.styling: Sticky full-width indigo button 'Publish Note'; disabled grey until file, title, and course are filled.
key_components.interaction: Uploads file with progress bar; opens the new Note Detail.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Upload tab or the Home empty state. After publishing, the note appears in the course list and its Note Detail opens.

screens.name: Study Groups
screens.purpose: Discover, create, join, and manage study groups, including approving requests as admin.

key_components.name: Groups Header
key_components.styling: Indigo header titled 'Study Groups' with a search icon button.
key_components.interaction: Search icon opens group search by course.

key_components.name: Group Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented tabs 'Discover', 'My Groups', 'Requests (3)'; active tab has indigo underline.
key_components.interaction: Switches the list below.

key_components.name: Group Card
key_components.styling: Rounded card with group image, name 'CS101 Finals Crew', course tag, '12 members', a Public or Private badge.
key_components.interaction: Opens group details sheet with members and notes.

key_components.name: Join Button
key_components.styling: Indigo pill on each card: 'Join' for public groups, 'Request to Join' for private groups.
key_components.interaction: Joins instantly or sends request; button becomes 'Requested'.

key_components.name: Join Request Row
key_components.styling: Row with avatar, name, course, green 'Approve' and outlined red 'Reject' buttons.
key_components.interaction: Approve adds member; Reject removes the request.

key_components.name: Member Row
key_components.styling: Member list for admins with avatar, name, role label, and a trash icon button.
key_components.interaction: Trash opens confirm dialog to remove member.

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.styling: Floating amber circular button with plus icon, shadow, above bottom navigation.
key_components.interaction: Opens Create Group modal.

key_components.name: Create Group Modal
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with 'Group name' and 'Course' inputs, Public/Private toggle, and indigo 'Create Group' button.
key_components.interaction: Creates group, makes user admin, adds it to My Groups.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with four tabs; 'Groups' is active in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Opened from the Groups tab. Users browse, join, or create groups; admins handle requests and members in the same screen.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: View and edit profile and courses, access bookmarks, and manage account and privacy.

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: Indigo gradient header with a round avatar, name 'Maya Chen', 'Verified student' badge, and university.
key_components.interaction: Avatar tap changes the profile photo.

key_components.name: Edit Profile Button
key_components.styling: White outlined pill 'Edit Profile' on the header, right-aligned.
key_components.interaction: Switches the fields below to editable mode.

key_components.name: Bio Input
key_components.styling: Rounded multiline field with placeholder 'Tell peers about your study interests'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to edit bio.

key_components.name: My Courses Chips
key_components.styling: Wrap of indigo-tint chips like 'CS101' and 'BIO204' with an 'Add course' dashed chip.
key_components.interaction: Add chip opens course picker; tap chip to remove.

key_components.name: Save Changes Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo button 'Save Changes', visible in edit mode.
key_components.interaction: Saves profile and shows a success toast.

key_components.name: Content Tabs
key_components.styling: Tabs 'Bookmarks' and 'My Uploads' with indigo underline on the active tab.
key_components.interaction: Switches the note list below.

key_components.name: Bookmarked Note Row
key_components.styling: Compact rows with thumbnail, title, course, rating, and a filled amber bookmark icon.
key_components.interaction: Opens Note Detail; bookmark icon removes it from list.

key_components.name: Moderation Queue Link
key_components.styling: Settings row 'Moderation Queue' with a red count badge '5'; visible to moderators only.
key_components.interaction: Opens Moderation Queue screen.

key_components.name: Delete Account Button
key_components.styling: Red outlined button 'Delete Account and Data' with a note about the 30-day GDPR deletion window.
key_components.interaction: Opens confirmation dialog before deleting.

screens.user_flow: Opened from the Profile tab. Users edit details, revisit bookmarks, and delete their account; moderators continue to the Moderation Queue.

screens.name: Moderation Queue
screens.purpose: Let moderators review reports, remove content, and suspend users.

key_components.name: Queue Header
key_components.styling: Indigo top bar with back arrow, title 'Moderation Queue', and a filter icon.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Profile; filter opens type options.

key_components.name: Status Tabs
key_components.styling: Tabs 'Open (5)', 'Resolved'; active tab has indigo underline and bold text.
key_components.interaction: Switches between open and resolved reports.

key_components.name: Report Card
key_components.styling: Card with reported note thumbnail, title, reason badge 'Copyright', reporter, time, and a 'Review' link.
key_components.interaction: Expands to show full report details.

key_components.name: Reason Details
key_components.styling: Grey inset panel with the reporter's comment and the author's name and past violation count.
key_components.interaction: Author name opens their profile.

key_components.name: Remove Content Button
key_components.styling: Red filled button 'Remove Content' with trash icon.
key_components.interaction: Hides note from users and notifies the author.

key_components.name: Suspend User Button
key_components.styling: Red outlined button 'Suspend User' beside Remove Content.
key_components.interaction: Opens duration picker then confirm dialog.

key_components.name: Dismiss Report Button
key_components.styling: Grey text button 'Dismiss Report'.
key_components.interaction: Marks report resolved with no action.

key_components.name: Action Confirmation Toast
key_components.styling: Dark snackbar: 'Note removed. Author notified.' with an 'Undo' action.
key_components.interaction: Undo restores the item within 5 seconds.

screens.user_flow: Moderators arrive from the Profile moderation link. They review each report, act or dismiss, and return to Profile.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: Indigo fill, white bold text, 14px radius, 52px height, soft shadow.
ui_components.interaction: Press scales slightly; loading shows spinner.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: White fill, indigo 1.5px border and text, 12px radius.

ui_components.name: Danger Button
ui_components.styling: Red fill or outline for destructive actions like remove or delete.
ui_components.interaction: Always opens a confirmation before acting.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 52px height, 12px radius, light grey border; indigo focus ring; red border with helper text on error.

ui_components.name: Note Card
ui_components.styling: White, 16px radius, subtle shadow, thumbnail, title, tags, rating row.

ui_components.name: Chip
ui_components.styling: Pill shape, light indigo fill with indigo text; selected state solid indigo with white text.
ui_components.interaction: Tap toggles filter or removes tag.

ui_components.name: Top App Bar
ui_components.styling: 56px bar, indigo or white, centered title, back arrow, optional action icon.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar, top border, four icon-label tabs, indigo active state.

ui_components.name: Bottom Sheet
ui_components.styling: White sheet with 24px top radius, drag handle, dimmed backdrop.
ui_components.interaction: Swipe down or tap backdrop to dismiss.

ui_components.name: Toast
ui_components.styling: Dark rounded snackbar with white text; green accent for success, red for errors.

responsive_design: Mobile-first single column at 360px+. Tablets use a two-column note grid. Desktop uses a left sidebar instead of the bottom bar, with content capped at 1100px. Touch targets are at least 44px.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, visible focus rings, labels on all inputs and icon buttons, rating stars operable by keyboard, status shown with text as well as color, and support for 200% text zoom.
animations: Screen transitions slide 250ms. Bottom sheets slide up with a fading backdrop. Buttons press-scale to 0.97. Bookmark toggles pop. Rating stars fill in sequence. Toasts fade. Reduced-motion is respected.
icons: Outline icons only from the set: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. 24px, 2px stroke, with a filled style for active or selected states. No emojis.
